title: The Temple
lead: The place where God's presence lived among his people: the tabernacle in the wilderness (Exodus 25–40), Solomon's temple, the second temple rebuilt after the exile and enlarged by Herod, destroyed in AD 70. Many scholars see Eden as the first sanctuary (Genesis 2). The New Testament calls Jesus' body, the church and believers a temple, and Revelation's new Jerusalem has no temple, "because the Lord God, the All-Powerful, and the Lamb are its temple" (Revelation 21:22).
